title: Intel GPU - Godot crashes when opening/creating scene with a MeshInstance3D
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible: v4.6.dev6.official [dec5a373d] , v4.6.beta1.official [d743736f8] , v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47] , v4.6.beta3.official [76dda5c6c] - Non-reproducible: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033] , v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4] , v4.6.dev2.official [7864ac801] , v4.6.dev3.official [9d84f3d13] , v4.6.dev4.official [bd2ca13c6] , v4.6.dev5.official [f5918a9d3] ### System information Godot v4.6.beta3 - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (TGL GT2) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11370H @ 3.30GHz (8 threads) - 62.52 GiB memory ### Issue description The editor will crash when opening a scene with a MeshInstance3D. There are some odd conditions: 1. If the MeshInstance3D is textured, the editor will crash only upon selecting the object. 2. If the MeshInstance3D has no material, and the scene has both environment and light disabled, the editor will not crash. Interestingly the exported project doesn't seem to crash (tested on 4.6 beta3). Stack trace: ``` ERROR: /root: The caller thread can't call the function `propagate_notification()` on this node. Use `call_deferred()` or `call_deferred_thread_group()` instead. at: propagate_notification (scene/main/node.cpp:2597) ================================================================ handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.dev6.official (dec5a373d97cbadce5e1fabe6095ae9957ff3aa6) Dumping the backtrace. Create a new project. 2. Create a new 3D scene. 3. Add MeshInstance3D to the scene. 4. Set the Cube mesh as the mesh on the MeshInstance3D. If a scene like that is setup in a previous version of the editor (4.6 dev5 and earlier), opening that scene will always crash the newer versions of the editor (4.6 dev6 and later). ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [crash-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24498833/crash-test.zip)
